evidence: Enables the -Wmissing-noreturn compiler warning flag in CMakeLists.txt across builds.
rationale: Enabling the -Wmissing-noreturn compiler warning prevents compiler analysis false positives and keeps non-returning functions annotated consistently. The PR description notes that 'Missing [[noreturn]] attributes can cause compiler false positives and other issues' (PR description). While beneficial for clean builds and static diagnostics, it is reasonably deferrable hygiene.
